description: This file defines functions for managing plugin providers, including resolving plugin IDs based on configuration, provider, and model references. It also exports utility functions and testing helpers related to plugin registry and provider resolution.

methods.name: withBundledProviderVitestCompat
methods.description: Wraps plugin configuration with Vitest compatibility.

methods.name: resolveBundledProviderCompatPluginIds
methods.description: Resolves plugin IDs for bundled providers based on optional filtering.

methods.name: resolveEnabledProviderPluginIds
methods.description: Resolves plugin IDs for enabled providers based on configuration and activation state.

methods.name: resolveManifestRegistry
methods.description: Resolves the plugin manifest registry, optionally using a provided registry.

methods.name: splitExplicitModelRef
methods.description: Parses a model reference string into provider and model ID components.

methods.name: resolveModelSupportMatchKind
methods.description: Determines if a model ID matches a plugin's pattern or prefix support.

methods.name: resolveOwningPluginIdsForProvider
methods.description: Finds plugin IDs that own a given provider.

methods.name: resolveOwningPluginIdsForModelRef
methods.description: Finds plugin IDs that own a specific model reference.

methods.name: resolveOwningPluginIdsForModelRefs
methods.description: Finds plugin IDs owning multiple models.

methods.name: resolveNonBundledProviderPluginIds
methods.description: Resolves plugin IDs for non-bundled providers based on activation state.

methods.name: resolveCatalogHookProviderPluginIds
methods.description: Resolves plugin IDs for catalog hook providers, combining enabled and bundled-compatible plugins.
